summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass. Nothing is committed. Mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check and formatting rules were applied by reading the code; only a line-length check (awk, 88 columns) was actually run, and it is clean.
